description: REQ-R4 explicitly states 'existing > 0 and new == existing → NO-OP, counted in skipped_dup (idempotent replay).' EDGE-E5 reinforces this: 'HIGHEST value wins per REQ-R4 monotone-max; lower/equal ones counted as skipped_dup'. However, merge_realized in reconciler.py line 44-46 returns status='noop' when e == n (both positive), so the case is NOT counted in skipped_dup. Test test_same_value_noop (test_reconciler.py:42-44) locks in the wrong behavior by asserting s == 'noop'. Since 'noop' does not increment skipped_dup (see reconciler.py line 196 comment '# "noop" doesn't increment either'), the report will systematically under-count idempotent replays of the same-value settle. This is the exact failure mode REQ-R4 was written to prevent (Coconala re-settle of the same amount).
